title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
descriptionText:
*About Devfum*

Devfum is a forward-thinking technology company focused on delivering web development, AI, and extended reality (XR) solutions that redefine industries. At Devfum, we foster a collaborative environment where top talent can thrive. You will work on cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and enjoy opportunities for continuous learning and career growth. Join us and be part of a team shaping the future of digital innovation.

*Vision:* _“To be the world’s pioneering digital experience provider.”_

*Why Join Devfum?*

We offer an environment that fosters growth, learning, and work-life balance, ensuring that our employees feel valued and motivated.

* *Bi-Annual Salary Increments:* Recognizing your contributions regularly.
* *Clear Career Growth Roadmap:* Software Engineer → Senior Software Engineer → Engineering Manager.
* *Continuous Learning:* Access to paid courses to enhance your skills.
* *Daily Meals:* Enjoy complimentary lunch and tea/coffee.
* *Recreational Activities:* Monthly sports activities and annual company tours.

*Role Overview*

We are hiring a Mid-Level Software Engineer who is strong in TypeScript, has solid backend architecture and database experience, and has hands-on exposure to DevOps in real production environments.

This role sits between junior execution and senior delivery ownership. You will work under a Senior Software Engineer to own features end-to-end, mentor junior engineers, and support deployments. This is a role for a builder who thinks in terms of edge cases, data integrity, and failure scenarios — not just happy paths.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Own full features/modules from implementation to release. Design the approach before coding and ensure features are stable, tested, and production-ready.
* Design REST APIs with proper validation and error handling. Implement layered backend architectures (controllers, services, data access) and handle role-based access control.
* Build production-ready interfaces using React.js and Next.js. Handle client-side/server-side rendering and state management.
* Translate high-level user stories into clear tasks for junior engineers. Review PRs and guide juniors to reduce rework.
* Handle deployments to staging and production (Linux/Cloud — AWS/DigitalOcean), debug basic production issues, check logs, and manage environment variables.

*Required Qualifications*

* 2–3 years of real production experience. You must have shipped real features to production.
* Technical Stack (Non-Negotiable):
* *Primary Language:* TypeScript (large codebases, interfaces, generics, strict type safety ).
* *Frontend:* React.js, Next.js, component-based architecture.
* *Databases:* PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or MySQL with schema design, data modeling, and ORMs (Prisma, TypeORM, Mongoose).
* *Auth:* Supabase Auth, Firebase, Auth0, or NextAuth.
* *Integrations:* Third-party APIs (Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI), real-time features (WebSockets/Supabase Realtime), or cloud storage (AWS S3).

*Soft Skills & Mindset*

* You take responsibility for your code and decisions.
* You communicate clearly, ask questions early, and respect engineering processes.

*Work Schedule*

Standard Hours: 12:00 PM – 09:00 PM, Monday to Friday.

*Salary Range*

PKR 200,000 – PKR 250,000

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs200,000.00 - Rs250,000.00 per month

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
descriptionText:
About Position:

As an Automation QA Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing automated test scripts to verify the functionality and performance of our fintech applications. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining the high quality and security standards that our clients expect.

Job Tittle:

Software Quality Assurance Engineer

Timings: 9:00 am – 6:00 pm

Location: Gulberg Greens, Islamabad

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard tools for fintech applications.

* Collaborate with the development team to understand application requirements and ensure test coverage.

* Execute test cases to verify the functionality, performance, and security of fintech applications.

* Participate in the design and execution of load and performance testing. • Work closely with cross-functional teams to identify and troubleshoot issues, and ensure t imely resolution.

* Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation, including test plans and test reports.

* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and integration.

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

* Proven experience of 3-5 years as an Automation QA Engineer, with a strong background in f intech and Telco industry

* Proficiency in test automation tools and frameworks, such as Selenium, Appium, or similar. • Experience with scripting and programming languages, e.g., Java, Python, or Ruby.

* Familiarity with fintech applications, financial protocols, and data security.

* Solid understanding of software development processes and methodologies.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze and report defects effectively.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

* Performance test results experience with Postman, Jmeter and K6 Preferred

Qualifications:

* Relevant certifications in quality assurance, test automation, or fintech.

* Experience with test management tools like JIRA, TestRail, or similar.

* Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.

* Familiarity with financial regulatory standards and compliance in the fintech industry.

* Previous experience in testing mobile applications and APIs.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Up to Rs250,000.00 per month

title: Database Engineer
descriptionText:
Database / Systems Engineer (Visual Object Indexing & Retrieval)
Experience: 3–5 Years
Location: Remote

Job Overview

Hiring a Database / Systems Engineer to design and build high-performance systems for storing and retrieving visual object data. You will work on scalable object memory systems that help AI and robotics platforms recognize, compare, and reason about objects using images, embeddings, and metadata.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop scalable databases for visual object storage.
* Implement fast similarity search and ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) systems.
* Build data ingestion pipelines for images, embeddings, and metadata.
* Optimize indexing strategies, memory usage, and query performance.
* Design flexible schemas with versioning and future scalability.
* Develop APIs for object search, confidence scoring, and novelty detection.
* Maintain and rebuild indexes for large-scale datasets.
* Monitor system performance, latency, and retrieval accuracy.
* Collaborate with ML engineers to improve embedding quality and results.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in backend, systems, or database engineering.
* Strong experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building scalable data pipelines.
* Good understanding of indexing, caching, and system performance.

Nice to Have (Bonus Skills)

* Experience with vector search tools (FAISS, Milvus, Pinecone, HNSWlib, Annoy).
* Experience with ML pipelines or image processing systems.
* Knowledge of ANN algorithms.
* Interest in robotics, AI, or computer vision.

Hiring

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs300,000.00 - Rs350,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: SQA Engineer
descriptionText:
*Job Summary:*

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive *Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Engineer* to join our QA team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our software applications through thorough testing, effective collaboration, and continuous process improvement.

*Key Responsibilities:*

* *Testing and Analysis:* Conduct comprehensive testing of software applications to identify bugs, errors, and usability issues across platforms.
* *Test Planning:* Develop detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios based on project requirements and technical documentation.
* *Documentation:* Create and maintain test documentation including test cases, procedures, and test results.
* *Defect Tracking:* Identify, document, and manage software defects using defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Bugzilla).
* *Regression Testing:* Execute regression tests to ensure system integrity following code changes or updates.
* *Automation:* Develop and maintain automated test scripts to streamline and scale testing efforts where applicable.
* *Collaboration:* Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on quality expectations and product goals.
* *Quality Assurance Processes:* Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA methodologies, standards, and best practices.

*Required Skills and Qualifications:*

* *Testing Expertise:* Strong knowledge of various testing types (manual, automated, regression, functional, performance, etc.).
* *Programming Knowledge:* Understanding of programming/scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript) to develop automated tests.
* *Analytical Skills:* Ability to interpret software requirements and translate them into actionable test cases.
* *Attention to Detail:* Precision in identifying and documenting software issues.
* *Communication:* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* *Problem-Solving:* Strong troubleshooting skills to analyze and resolve software defects.
* *Adaptability:* Willingness to learn new tools and adapt to changing technologies and project needs.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Experience with automated testing tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, TestNG, JUnit).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Knowledge of performance and security testing practices.

*Education & Experience:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience in software testing or quality assurance roles.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Rs150,000.00 - Rs300,000.00 per month



Application Question(s):
* What is your current salary?
* What is your expected salary?

descriptionText:
*About the Role*

We are seeking a *highly skilled and self-driven Senior Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer* with deep expertise in *React*, *Next.js*, and *AWS DevOps*. This role requires someone who can both execute and lead — an engineer who thrives in fast-paced environments, takes ownership, and is passionate about building scalable, modern web applications.

As a senior member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for full-cycle product development — from system architecture and coding to deployment and team mentoring.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using *React* and *Next.js*
* Architect full-stack solutions and ensure best practices in performance, security, and scalability
* Drive DevOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment automation using *AWS*
* Lead technical discussions, code reviews, and guide junior developers
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver impactful features
* Monitor and optimize application performance and infrastructure costs
* Proactively identify and resolve technical issues or roadblocks

*Requirements*

* *10+ years* of professional software development experience, ideally in a fast-paced or startup environment
* Strong proficiency in *React*, *Next.js*, JavaScript/TypeScript
* Deep experience with *AWS services* such as EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudFormation, CodePipeline, etc.
* Solid understanding of backend development (Node.js preferred) and RESTful API design
* Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL), caching, and scalable architecture patterns
* Strong DevOps mindset — comfortable with CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and infrastructure automation
* Ability to lead and mentor a team, drive initiatives independently, and communicate effectively

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience with GraphQL and microservices
* Familiarity with containerization tools (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes)
* Exposure to Agile methodologies and version control systems (e.g., Git)

*What We Offer*

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
* Flexible work schedule and remote-first culture
* Opportunity to take full ownership of projects and shape technical direction
* A collaborative, engineering-driven culture

Job Title: Infrastructure Engineer

*Job Summary*

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer who will operate as both a technical consultant and hands-on engineer, responsible for advising, planning, designing, and implementing modern infrastructure solutions. The role requires proven expertise across SASE and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Endpoint Management and Security, and a strong foundation in enterprise networking, including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, SDWAN and endpoint management platforms.

*Experience:* 8+ Years

*Key Responsibilities*

* Advise on and support network architecture fundamentals, routing, switching, firewall, and network security

* VPN technologies (site-to-site and remote access) and SDWAN.

* Advise, design, implement and support SASE based solutions including ZTNA, CASB, Secure Web gateway, RBI and more.

* Advise, design, implement, and manage Unified Endpoint Management and Security solution.

* Advise and implement enterprise endpoint management and security standards and best practices, covering vulnerabilities management and patching strategies, software deployments and distributions, browser security, application control, and Bitlocker.

* Manage and optimize endpoint asset management and inventory, ensuring accurate visibility, reporting, and tracking.

* Design and advise on OS deployment strategies (traditional imaging and modern provisioning)

* Provide advanced operational support and insights, including endpoint inventory, asset visibility, reporting, troubleshooting, and support.

•

Required Skills & Qualifications

Core Skills

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred
* 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering roles
* Solid knowledge of networking fundamentals (routing, switching, firewalls, VPN)
* Strong knowledge and experience with Zero Trust, ZTNA, SASE, and SD-WAN concepts
* Strong knowledge and experience with UEMS and with managing enterprise-scale identity, endpoint, and compliance environments
* Strong understanding identity platforms and directory services, such as Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.

Soft Skills

* Strong consulting, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills
* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities

title: AI Engineer
descriptionText:
*Job Title: AI Engineer*

Location: Gulberg Greens, Islamabad.

Experience Required: 2-3 years.

Type: Full Time, Onsite Role.

Job Overview

We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer specializing in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI with 2–3 years of hands-on experience in building, deploying, and optimizing AI-driven solutions. The role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop scalable, production-ready AI applications that deliver real business value.

*Key Responsibilities*

\* Develop and deploy applications using LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral)

\* Implement prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), MCP Servers and embedding-based solutions.

\* Fine-tune and optimize generative models for domain-specific use cases.

\* Design end-to-end Generative AI pipelines and workflows

\* Integrate AI capabilities into existing products via APIs and microservices.

\* Evaluate model performance, accuracy, latency, and cost efficiency.

\* Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, or Weaviate.

\* Ensure ethical AI usage, data privacy, and security compliance.

*Required Qualifications*

\* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.

\* 2–3 years of practical experience in AI/ML or applied Generative AI.

\* Strong proficiency in Python and AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face).

\* Hands-on experience with LLMs, transformers, and generative models.

\* Strong expertise to work with MCP servers and LangGraph.

\* Experience with prompt engineering, embeddings, and RAG architectures.

\* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

\* Solid understanding of software engineering best practices.

*Preferred Skills*

\* Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs (LLaMA, Falcon, Mistral, etc.)

\* Knowledge of LangChain, LIamaIndex, or similar orchestration frameworks.

\* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

\* Understanding of MLOps concepts and model monitoring.

\* Exposure to multimodal AI (text, image, or audio-based models).

Job Types: Full-time, Contract

Pay: Rs140,000.00 - Rs150,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

About us

WallStreetBets is the largest finance community in the world.

With over 20 million users, we’re the movement that helped redefine retail investing and put power back into the hands of everyday traders. From our humble beginnings on Reddit to becoming a global household name during the GameStop saga, our influence has shaped markets, culture, and the future of finance.

And we’re just getting started.

Today, our mission is stronger than ever: minimize the gap between retail and institutions by giving people access to world-class tools, real-time data, community intelligence, and a platform built for the next generation of traders. Our goal? Accelerate one billion people to financial security, and have fun doing it.

Position summary

We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to help build the core infrastructure behind the new WallStreetBets platform, powering real-time data, earnings call insights, social sentiment, community feeds, and trader-focused tools.

You'll work across the stack to ship high-performance, scalable features used by millions of traders. From backend services and APIs to front-end components and data-driven experiences, you’ll play a key role in defining the engineering foundation of a globally recognized fintech product.

This is an opportunity to join early, move fast, and build something that truly impacts how retail traders interact with markets. This role is open to applicants anywhere in the world and will be hired as a contractor. At WallStreetBets, we believe great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where all voices are heard.

If building the future of social finance with speed, creativity, and WSB swagger sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d love to meet you.

Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.

Develop responsive, high-quality web features using modern frontend frameworks.

Work with real-time financial data, websockets, event-driven systems, and market APIs.

Build community-driven experiences such as feeds, notifications, and sentiment tools.

Implement dashboards and interfaces that make financial data clear and accessible.

Collaborate closely with product, design, and mobile teams to deliver features quickly.

Improve overall system performance, reliability, testing, and automation.

Participate in architectural planning and long-term technical decision-making.

5+ years of software engineering experience in a full stack or backend-focused role.

Collaborative mindset, and the ability to work with a globally distributed team

*Role Overview:*Devfum is hiring a Mid-Level AI Engineer to design, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems.This is not a research only role and not a pure backend role. It is a backend heavy AI engineering role focused on building real AI products end to end.

* AI system architecture

* Custom model training and fine-tuning
* GPU-based deployment and inference optimization
* Production AI infrastructure and monitoring

* Design AI solutions from problem definition to production

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML (or equivalent practical experience)
* 2–3 years of real AI/ML engineering experience
* Proven experience deploying AI/ML or LLM systems to production
* Hands-on experience with GPUs (CUDA/NVIDIA), and operating inference workloads on GPU servers

* Familiarity with inference optimization concepts (batching, quantization FP16/INT8, ONNX/TensorRT)

* Clear communicator (written + verbal), can explain tradeoffs and decisions
* Prioritizes reliability and measurable outcomes over hype and experimentation for its own sake
* Comfortable with responsibility and operating production systems on Linux environments
